 Mansfield University to close
 November 17, 2026 
 1 min read 
 PHOTO PROVIDED
Residence halls at Mansfield University are pictured in this promotional photo. 
 Trending
 LOCK HAVEN -- The Mansfield University campus is closing.
 According to an email to Commonwealth University students, faculty and staff obtained by The Express, the Mansfield University branch of Commonwealth University has received an order "for the orderly wind-down of operations at the Mansfield campus, with a proposed closure no later than June 30, 2028."
 That framework, according to the email, "is due...no later than December 8, 2026."
 The news was delivered by university president Jeffrey Osgood, who said that these orders came from the Chancellor's Office. 
 The prospective closing of CU-Mansfield comes at an already uncertain time for CU-Lock Haven employees, who have been working under a looming potential retrenchment process which could see the university cut faculty. 
 The email states that "The Chancellor's letter states an aim of minimizing employee losses to the greatest extent possible, and we share that aim."
 "We do not yet know how the Mansfield wind-down will affect that [retrenchment] process. We will share updates on both with students, employees, alumni, donors and the broader community as the work progresses," the email continues. 
 This is a developing story, and additional comments and details will be published as they become available.
